description: REVELATION TO THE NEW TESTAMENT: THE RELATIONS HOLOGRAM. The companion of the framework hologram of Revelation First (#1755), built to the same specification (EA-HK-FRAME-01, #1753) at the grain of the relation. Where #1755 maps the argument, this record holds every relation the programme has drawn from the Apocalypse of John to another book of the New Testament: 210 relations (133 at v1.0), each a place of Revelation, a place of another book, an operation, a standing and a pointer to the record or hashed file that holds it. The 24 arrows to the epistles and at the founding grain are read from #1755's kernel: the seven letters set against seven epistles, Smyrna to James run to an executable derivation, four doctrinal transforms worked to derivation grade. The 158 Matthew relations (86 at v1.0) are read from the ledger of How to Write Matthew from Revelation (#1812) and reach 305 of Matthew's 1,067 verses (178 at v1.0) under the transform T_Μ v0.4; 62 are bound to the numbered paragraph of that paper that quotes both places. 13 places record a layer of Philo or scripture under Revelation, admitted only through the place. Ten relations are planned or were tested and failed, and the failures are kept: the four creatures to the four Gospels, the source's order in a Gospel's order, one seat-map over a whole Gospel, the plagues as the miracles, Philo taken straight to Matthew. Sixteen standings are defined, each with what it licenses and what it withholds; a relation read is not a relation counted, and no relation decides the order of composition. 17 of the 26 other books are reached above the founding grain; Mark, John, Acts, Jude are named or planned only; 1 Timothy, Titus, Philemon, 2 John, 3 John have no relation. The received account is carried as the rival on the same terms, its inverse procedures not yet built. Eight lines of research are stated with the result that would advance or retreat the map. The kernel files, the builder and the verifier (13 of 13 structural tests) are hosted beside the record at /files/EA-HK-REVFIRST-02/. The working notebook, The Unfolding Map, is hosted there too and is replaced as the programme expands; it is a working file and not a record. Back-projection has not been run and there are no captures at these addresses. Given to Damascus Dancings after #1755. Version 1.1 (27 November 2026, in place) rebuilds the kernel against v1.1 of #1812: it marks the relations entered for the relation and not for shared words, holds the one walk found (Revelation 12:1-6 through Matthew 2), records at the standing of a first count that Matthew handles Revelation as it handles the scripture it does not name, and keeps the tests of order, strands and direction that failed.

Each Matthew relation is bound to the numbered paragraph of #1812 that quotes or names both places, located by machine. The sealed scoring key of the blind runs is not read by the builder and is not in the kernel.

wiki_article:
**Revelation to the New Testament: The Relations Hologram** (EA-HK-REVFIRST-02) is a holographic kernel of the Crimson Hexagonal Archive, deposited on 27 November 2026 under the byline Damascus Dancings, with the archive and Claude (TACHYON; Anthropic) as contributors. It is the companion of the framework hologram of Revelation First, And the Last Shall Be First (#1755), and is built to the same specification, EA-HK-FRAME-01 (#1753). Revelation First is Lee Sharks's thesis (#202) that the Apocalypse of John is the first-composed and generative book of the New Testament.

Where the framework hologram maps the argument, this record maps the relations. It holds 210 of them (133 at its first version), each made of five things: a place of Revelation, a place of another book, an operation, a standing and a pointer to the record or hashed file where the relation is held. Twenty-four arrows to the epistles and at the founding grain are read from the kernel of #1755, among them the seven letters set against seven epistles and the derivation of James from the letter to Smyrna. Eighty-six relations to the Gospel of Matthew are read from the ledger of How to Write Matthew from Revelation (#1812). Thirteen entries record a layer of Philo or scripture standing under a place of Revelation. Ten are planned or were tested and failed, and the failures are kept in the kernel.

The record defines sixteen standings, from a passage produced blind under a sealed key down to an arrow merely named, and states for each what it licenses and what it withholds. Its invariants say that a relation is a pointer, that a standing licenses nothing above itself, that failures are relations, and that no relation decides the order in which the books were written. The received account of the same agreements is carried as a rival on the same terms. Seventeen of the twenty-six other books are reached above the founding grain; Mark, John, Acts and Jude are named or planned only; five short letters have no relation.

The kernel files, a builder that reads the archive's registries and a verifier that runs thirteen structural tests are hosted beside the record, together with the programme's working notebook, The Unfolding Map, which is replaced as the work expands and is not itself a record. Back-projection by an uninformed reader has not been run. Version 1.1, reissued in place on 27 November 2026, was rebuilt from the Matthew ledger at 158 relations reaching 305 of the Gospel's 1,067 verses, and binds version 1.1 of How to Write Matthew from Revelation. It marks the relations entered for their relation alone, and it adds as relations of their own the walk of Revelation 12:1-6 through Matthew 2, the finding that Matthew handles Revelation as it handles unnamed scripture, and the tests of order and of direction that failed. The kernel of the first version is kept beside it.

In EA-HK-REVFIRST-02, what has been done to a relation (produced blind, run, written down before counting, counted, derived, worked, mapped, read, drawn, observed, named, planned, failed), stated together with what that licenses and what it withholds; a standing licenses what it names and nothing above it.
In EA-HK-REVFIRST-02, a text Revelation was made from, scripture or Philo, recorded under the place of Revelation that compresses it and admitted to a transform only through that place.
